verdict.rationale: The pack offers only indirect hints of an access model. A workspace-owner role can manage MCP client access, and connections can reach only Custom Agents explicitly shared with them, which implies role- and sharing-based controls exist. Nothing describes assigning view/edit permissions or roles to people on pages or databases. Missing for 10: documented page/database-level view vs. edit permissions for users, role definitions (member/guest/admin), group or teamspace permission management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
